releaseName: Don't lose your data to in-app browsers
notes: If you open the app from inside Instagram, TikTok, or Facebook, you'll now see a warning at the top. Those apps store your data in a separate sandbox - debts you enter there won't appear when you visit the site normally, and you can't add the app to your home screen. The banner shows exactly how to open it in your real browser, with a one-tap Copy link button.
